headline.text: L3 cleared ingredient pump vapor lock and mold jam, but cooler 3 may have run with *covers off*.

per_plant_summary.L1: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 had a mold jam and table alignment issue in the morning, both cleared quickly. Ingredient tank 2 pump failed with a loud screech at 19:58 but maintenance found it was vapor-locked and cleared it by 09:02. Line stopped for level 2 cleaning at 13:01 and restarted successfully at 05:09. Quality found cooler 3 plastic covers off during overnight cleaning with bolts sitting loose, potentially ran with them off.

notes.text: Flow wrap packaging for Tuesday's truffle product was staged in ML4 area but machine setup not yet ready.
Almond dust observed in FFS vibratory loader during Saturday cleaning, cleanup suggested before Tuesday run.

resolved.title: Ingredient tank 2 pump failure
resolved.summary: Loud screeching from red valve on ingredient tank 2, maintenance called at 19:58 and diagnosed blown pump.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:02 — "vapor locked, had an air pocket at the pump, cleared the air and it is working properly now" (Nelson Cook). Two spare pumps ordered for stock.

resolved.title: Mold jam in mold exchanger area
resolved.summary: WDS auto-stopped for mold jam, cleared and restarted within 2 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:35 — "WDS startup; it was stopped for 15 min" (ML4 WDS).

resolved.title: Table tilting from loose bolts
resolved.summary: Depositor table tilted due to loose mounting bolts, causing alignment issues.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:33 — "Tightened them up and running again" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: ML4 line stop for level 2 cleaning
resolved.summary: Depositing stopped at 13:01 for scheduled level 2 weekend cleaning, line down overnight.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:09 — "Long Belt is running well" (ML4 WDS). Level 2 clean completed and passed final visual and ATP at 06:57.

needs_attention.title: Cord floor strip repeatedly missing
needs_attention.summary: Safety cover strip missing for 4th time after replacement, creating trip hazard at floor junction.
needs_attention.status: New requirement implemented at 12:22 requiring each shift to post confirmation strip is in place until plant can prove safety culture compliance.

needs_attention.title: Plastic bearing tracking concern in PTL 2
needs_attention.summary: Attempted retrieval of plastic bearing from yesterday, not found in filter or PTL 2 hopper; question about potential second bearing dropped by operator.
needs_attention.status: Filter and hopper checked at 16:19, second bearing concern investigated and not found, but retrieval of original bearing incomplete.

needs_attention.title: Cooler 3 plastic covers off during production
needs_attention.summary: Plastic covers found removed from cooler 3 during overnight cleaning with bolts sitting loose in corners, line may have run Wednesday with covers off.
needs_attention.status: Discovered at 23:01 during 3rd shift cleaning setup; Shane confirmed 2nd shift did not touch cooler 3, work was done Wednesday, investigation pending.

needs_attention.title: Gondola parts left by prior shift
needs_attention.summary: Unidentified hardware and components found at gondola during overnight cleaning, unknown if prior shift work was completed.
needs_attention.status: Raised at 05:27 by 3rd shift lead; Chad requested shift identification at 08:22, Rose investigating as of 08:57.
